answer: The use of multi-authority decentralized identity protocols can provide Sybil resistance by requiring agents to possess unique cryptographic credentials tied to their physical identities, thereby limiting the scope of a fake-identity attack to the horizon of their physical presence. As the tide of malicious activity ebbs and flows, honest agents' credentials serve as a constant reference point, preventing a single fake identity from gaining traction and causing widespread disruption, as honest agents wander freely without fear of impersonation.
